title: Stellahedral geometry of partially ordered sets
summary: We introduce a transformation on partially ordered sets, termed the \emph{stellahedral transform}, with notable features. It preserves the properties of being Eulerian, Cohen--Macaulay, and of being the face poset of a polytope. Furthermore, it admits an explicit geometric realization for convex polytopes and specializes to the construction that takes a simplex to the stellahedron. One motivation for this definition comes from the theory of toric $h$-polynomials and (augmented) Chow polynomials of Eulerian posets.
